summary: {coordinator} brings residents into a trial of a county online service before launch.
realLife: Merced agreed to combine automated checks with testing by people with different disabilities before opening new online services to the public.
gates: The county is preparing a new online service and recruits people to try it.
inGame: needs: the proposed service, test task and user-reported result.

turns.writesBack: The launch review records the failed task.

turns.what: The coordinator records the result of the second attempt.
turns.pulledBy: A tester can complete the repaired form.
turns.writesBack: The retest is attached to the launch decision.
